# Toolbox

Use the authorized connector. Collect the user's required values; upload local file inputs
and substitute the returned platform references. Submit once, retain the job ID, poll
and inspect all returned artifacts. Never invent inputs or reuse another user's references.

## Binding Site Prediction (fpocket)

Binding Site Prediction (fpocket)

Exact job name: `Binding_Site_Prediction`.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pdb_path` | string | yes | file_or_value | PDB ID, AlphaFold UniProt ID, or an uploaded `.pdb` platform path; no SMILES input is used. |

## Molecular Docking

Predict ligand poses and docking scores within a defined protein search region using AutoDock Vina in basic, rigid-receptor mode. Inspect the returned poses and available interaction artifacts; docking scores are estimates, not measured binding affinities. Historical worker-failure notices still apply.

[Product description and result interpretation](../boltchem-product-guide.md#molecular-docking)

Exact job name: `Vina_basic_docking`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target_name` | string | yes | value | Target/receptor label |
| `processed_pdb` | string | yes | file | Upload the required file and use the returned cloud path; text pasting is not accepted. |
| `center_x` | string | yes | value | Binding-box center X; live schema requires a string |
| `center_y` | string | yes | value | Binding-box center Y; live schema requires a string |
| `center_z` | string | yes | value | Binding-box center Z; live schema requires a string |
| `max_radius_size` | string | yes | value | Binding-box size; live schema requires a string |
| `exhaustivness` | string | yes | value | Preserve misspelling; supported values include `8`, `16`, `32` as strings |
| `upload_sdf` | string | yes | value | String flag: exact documented values "True" or "False". |
| `smiles` | string | yes | file | Upload the required file and use the returned cloud path; text pasting is not accepted. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

## Flexible Docking

Predict ligand poses and docking scores with AutoDock Vina while allowing explicitly selected receptor residues to be flexible. Use the documented search-region and ligand inputs, and inspect the returned artifacts rather than assuming every product-level visualization is available.

[Product description and result interpretation](../boltchem-product-guide.md#molecular-docking)

Exact job name: `Vina_Flexible_Docking`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target_name` | string | yes | value | User-supplied target/receptor label. Screenshot text is not a default. |
| `processed_pdb` | string | yes | file | Upload the processed receptor PDB and use the returned platform storage path. |
| `center_x` | string | yes | value | Finite numeric string for the validated binding-pocket X coordinate; never copy screenshot values. |
| `center_y` | string | yes | value | Finite numeric string for the validated binding-pocket Y coordinate; never copy screenshot values. |
| `center_z` | string | yes | value | Finite numeric string for the validated binding-pocket Z coordinate; never copy screenshot values. |
| `max_radius_size` | string | yes | value | Positive numeric string for the binding-pocket diameter; never copy screenshot values. |
| `exhaustivness` | string | yes | value | Preserve the backend misspelling. User must choose one supported value. |
| `upload_sdf` | string | yes | value | Whether to return docked poses in SDF format. |
| `flexible_residues` | array | yes | value | User-confirmed receptor residue identifiers. Every entry must exist in the processed receptor; do not fabricate residues. |
| `smiles` | string | yes | file | Uploaded ligand CSV platform path ending in .csv, not a direct SMILES string. Upload the CSV using input_field="smiles". The Node API rejected inline SMILES with "smiles must be a .csv file"; CSV column names are not yet confirmed for flexible docking. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "target_name": {
      "description": "User-supplied target/receptor label. Screenshot text is not a default.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "processed_pdb": {
      "description": "Upload the processed receptor PDB and use the returned platform storage path.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "center_x": {
      "description": "Finite numeric string for the validated binding-pocket X coordinate; never copy screenshot values.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "x-numeric-string": true
    },
    "center_y": {
      "description": "Finite numeric string for the validated binding-pocket Y coordinate; never copy screenshot values.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "x-numeric-string": true
    },
    "center_z": {
      "description": "Finite numeric string for the validated binding-pocket Z coordinate; never copy screenshot values.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "x-numeric-string": true
    },
    "max_radius_size": {
      "description": "Positive numeric string for the binding-pocket diameter; never copy screenshot values.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "x-numeric-string": true
    },
    "exhaustivness": {
      "description": "Preserve the backend misspelling. User must choose one supported value.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "8",
        "16",
        "32"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "upload_sdf": {
      "description": "Whether to return docked poses in SDF format.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "True",
        "False"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "flexible_residues": {
      "description": "User-confirmed receptor residue identifiers. Every entry must exist in the processed receptor; do not fabricate residues.",
      "type": "array",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "smiles": {
      "description": "Uploaded ligand CSV platform path ending in .csv, not a direct SMILES string. Upload the CSV using input_field=\"smiles\". The Node API rejected inline SMILES with \"smiles must be a .csv file\"; CSV column names are not yet confirmed for flexible docking.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file",
      "pattern": "\\.csv$"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "target_name",
    "processed_pdb",
    "center_x",
    "center_y",
    "center_z",
    "max_radius_size",
    "exhaustivness",
    "upload_sdf",
    "flexible_residues",
    "smiles"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

## Molecular Docking — Vina Score Only Mode

Evaluate supplied ligand poses against a receptor using AutoDock Vina score-only mode. Report returned scores and available artifacts without claiming a new docking search, optimized pose or experimentally measured affinity.

[Product description and result interpretation](../boltchem-product-guide.md#molecular-docking)

Exact job name: `Vina_Score_only_docking`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target_name` | string | yes | value | Name of the target protein or receptor. |
| `processed_pdb` | string | yes | file | Uploaded and processed receptor PDB platform path. |
| `center_x` | string | yes | value | Binding-pocket center X coordinate serialized as a numeric string. |
| `center_y` | string | yes | value | Binding-pocket center Y coordinate serialized as a numeric string. |
| `center_z` | string | yes | value | Binding-pocket center Z coordinate serialized as a numeric string. |
| `max_radius_size` | string | yes | value | Binding-pocket diameter from the product UI, serialized under the historical `max_radius_size` wire key as a numeric string. |
| `exhaustivness` | string | yes | value | Docking exhaustiveness. Preserve the historical misspelled wire key. |
| `sdf_file` | string | yes | file | Uploaded ligand SDF platform path used to calculate complex binding affinity. |
| `upload_sdf` | string | yes | value | Whether to return docked poses in SDF format. This is a string boolean, not a JSON boolean. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

## Molecular Docking — DiffDock Mode

Predict ligand–protein binding poses with DiffDock in blind-docking mode without a predefined binding site. Inspect returned poses, confidence information and available interaction artifacts; do not treat confidence as a Vina energy score or experimentally measured affinity.

[Product description and result interpretation](../boltchem-product-guide.md#molecular-docking)

Exact job name: `Diffdock`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `processed_pdb` | string | yes | file | S3 path to PDB (upload first) |
| `input_csv` | string | yes | file | S3 path to CSV (upload first) |
| `upload_sdf` | string | yes | value | `"true"` or `"false"` |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
